text: * on mouseover it should animate to be bigger [...] Assistant: Got it. This supersedes the passive/click-through treatment: the HUD should be a real non-activating mini-player—larger typography, hover expansion, pause/resume, stop, 15-second back/forward, and a scrubbable timeline—while still never stealing focus. I’m folding all of that into the directory-path follow-up before it ships.
